about: S90 cross-examination of the revision 2 draft in five parts, 23 September 2026, after the single S90 call to Atria (s90_xexam_atria, 48 changes, 25,790 words) failed. The parts cover all 55 changes of the current draft (the change list as committed in 587eebf, the seven entries drafted from the settled S88 positions included), one group of the change list each, group A cut in two in the order of the text: A1, A2, B1, B2 and C. Each part carries the whole revised text (md5 9aecf2f30ce0b4523606b2b8409fdf37) and is sent whole, as the one user message, to both Atria and Mimo. Medium effort. One pass each (max_pass 1): a part that fails supports nothing, and its changes are reported as not examined by that model. Read under 'results/S90 How the cross-examination of the revision 2 draft will be read - written before sending.md' and 'results/S90 Parts - how they will be read, written before sending.md'.
